summary: Jeudan A/S operates as a real estate and service company in Denmark. It operates through two segments, Investment Properties and Project & Service. The company invests, develops, operates, and leases office, shop, office community, housing, warehouse, showroom, clinic, and other properties. It also provides property-related services, including bistro and canteen, design and interior, craftsman, cleaning, meeting and conference rooms, and plant services; car and valet parking services; and repair and renovation services. Jeudan A/S was founded in 1898 and is based in Copenhagen, Denmark.
